# hiok_vpn_client (Resource)

A Point-to-Site VPN client certificate and its connection profile.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `certificate_validity_days` (Number) Client certificate lifetime.
- `email` (String)
- `region` (String)

### Read-Only

- `config` (String, Sensitive) The client profile, embedding the CA, the client certificate and its private key. Write it to a file and hand it to the client.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
